Simple Workflow

How It Works

From setup to salary payout in three straightforward steps.

1

Add Employees & Salary Structure

Set up basic details, UAN, ESIC number, and salary components for every employee.

2

Input Attendance & Overtime

Log working days, approved leaves, and overtime hours for the payroll month.

3

Run Payroll & Export Reports

Generate net salary, and download EPFO ECR files and Bank Advice sheets instantly.
